manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, velocity is zero while gravity continues pulling down.
manifest.description: A tossed ball moves along a fixed height scale. A blue motion arrow shows velocity and a warm dashed arrow shows gravity. At the apex, motion is still while gravity remains constant.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
